snippet.title: Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish | Pillars of The Hunt
snippet.description:
Step into the brutal world of Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish and discover the core pillars that define the experience.

In this Dev Diary, take a deep dive into the key gameplay mechanics shaping your fight for survival. Whether you're strategizing with your team or adapting on the fly, every decision matters in the hunt.

Sharpen your instincts. Trust your allies. Survive the night.

Welcome to the World of Darkness. Welcome to Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish. Coming to Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and PC in Summer 2027. 

Wishlist now:
